extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether funding of £23,000 is available for a client's financial provision action at Glasgow Sheriff Court, where matrimonial property is around £230,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details of your client's financial provision action. We have noted the £23,000 sought, the matrimonial property figure of around £230,000, and that the action is at Glasgow Sheriff Court. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, any date fixed for proof or other hearings, details of the assets said to make up the matrimonial property and any existing charges over them, and your client's details for identity checks. A colleague will review the enquiry and come back to you.
